title: FTP, SFTP and WebDAV
description: Stored logins for FTP, FTPS and SFTP servers, and the SSH host keys you have confirmed. WebDAV shares authenticate through the authentication profiles under Network.

credentials.title: Remote logins
credentials.empty: No remote logins yet. Add one, or paste an ftp:// link with its credentials and it will be stored here.
credentials.name: Name
credentials.password_keep: Leave empty to keep the stored password
credentials.private_key_keep: Leave empty to keep the stored key
credentials.passphrase_keep: Leave empty to keep the stored passphrase
credentials.passive_hint: Turn this off only if the server requires active mode.
credentials.delete_confirm: Delete this login? Downloads using it will fall back to matching by host and port.
credentials.incomplete: This login has no stored credential yet
credentials.secrets_note: Passwords and keys are stored encrypted and are never shown again.

host_keys.title: Trusted SSH host keys
host_keys.description: An SFTP server is only used after you confirm its host key. If a confirmed key later changes, the transfer is blocked until you decide.
host_keys.empty: No SSH host keys confirmed yet.
host_keys.forget_confirm: Forget this host key? The next connection to this server will have to be confirmed again.
host_keys.unknown_description: rDownloader has not seen this server before. Compare the fingerprint with the one your server reports, for example with ssh-keyscan, and confirm it only if they match.
host_keys.changed_title: This server's host key has changed
host_keys.changed_description: The key this server presents is not the one you confirmed earlier. That happens when a server is rebuilt — but it looks exactly the same as someone intercepting the connection. Only confirm if you know the server changed.

listing.title: Files on the server
listing.single_file: This link points at a single file.
listing.no_resume: This server cannot continue an interrupted download; it would start over.
listing.truncated_entries: Only the first {limit} entries are shown. Narrow the link to a subfolder to see the rest.
listing.truncated_depth: Subfolders deeper than {limit} levels were not read.

settings.title: Transfer limits
settings.max_parallel_hint: Most servers limit how many sessions one account may open at once.
settings.timeout_hint: Applies to connecting, logging in and waiting for data.
settings.ssh_auto_trust: Trust an unknown SSH host key on first use
settings.ssh_auto_trust_hint: Off by default. Even when on, a key that changed is always blocked and never accepted automatically.

object_storage.title: Object storage
object_storage.description: Profiles for Amazon S3 and S3-compatible services such as MinIO, Ceph, Wasabi, Backblaze B2 or Cloudflare R2, for Azure Blob Storage and for Google Cloud Storage.
object_storage.usage_links: Paste links such as {link} into the LinkGrabber. A link uses the profile bound to its bucket, otherwise the only enabled profile without a bucket; {named} names one profile explicitly (by name or id).

source_hints.static: An access key ID and secret access key, optionally with a session token.
source_hints.ambient: Uses the credentials of the machine rDownloader runs on: environment variables, web identity, the container (ECS/EKS) or EC2 instance metadata. Nothing is stored here.
source_hints.anonymous: Unsigned requests, for publicly readable buckets only.

object_storage.name: Name
object_storage.endpoint_description: Empty for AWS S3 in the region below. TLS certificates are always validated; a private certificate authority goes into the custom CA under Network. http:// only for a local endpoint.
object_storage.region_description: Required for AWS; many S3-compatible services accept any value or us-east-1.
object_storage.bucket_description: Optional. Links to this bucket use this profile; left empty, the profile serves any bucket.
object_storage.addressing_description: Automatic: virtual-host style for AWS, path style with a custom endpoint.
object_storage.secret_keep: Stored. Leave empty to keep the stored secret.
object_storage.secrets_note: Secrets are stored encrypted and are never shown again.
object_storage.session_token_keep: Stored. Leave empty to keep the stored token.
object_storage.checksums_description: Every uploaded part carries a SHA-256 checksum the service verifies on receipt. Switch off only for a compatible service that refuses it.
object_storage.test_ok: {name}: the service answered and accepted the request.
object_storage.delete_description: Delete {name}? Links and upload targets that use this profile stop working until another profile serves them.

azure_hints.shared_access_signature: A SAS token or the whole SAS URL. When it expires, enter a new one here; downloads already started continue where they stopped.
azure_hints.ambient: Uses the identity of the machine rDownloader runs on: a service principal (AZURE_CLIENT_ID, AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET, AZURE_TENANT_ID), a workload identity or a managed identity. Nothing is stored here.
azure_hints.anonymous: Unsigned requests, for publicly readable containers only.

gcs_hints.static: The content of a service account's JSON key file.
gcs_hints.ambient: Uses the machine's application default credentials (GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS or gcloud auth application-default login) or its metadata server. Nothing is stored here.
gcs_hints.anonymous: Unsigned requests, for publicly readable buckets only.

object_storage.account_description: The account's name: 3 to 24 lowercase letters and digits.
object_storage.container_description: Optional. Links into this container use this profile; left empty, the profile serves any container of the account.
object_storage.endpoint_description_azure: Empty for the account's blob service (<account>.blob.core.windows.net). An address of its own for Azurite or another Azure cloud, such as http://127.0.0.1:10000/devstoreaccount1. TLS certificates are always validated.
object_storage.endpoint_description_gcs: Empty for storage.googleapis.com. An address of its own only for an emulator or a service in front of it. TLS certificates are always validated.
